subject: FinBank SIG assessment: request for Secure SDLC evidence (code review / CI / secrets / change mgmt)
messages:
From: BrightShield Audit <assessor@brightshield.audit>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Compliance Ops - FinBank <compliance@finbank.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: FinBank SIG: Secure SDLC evidence request (code review, CI/CD, secrets, change mgmt)

Rafael / FinBank team,

Thanks for the intro. As part of the SIG assessment for FinBank we need secure SDLC artifacts to validate engineering controls. Please provide the items below by EOD Friday (2028-02-03):

- Pull request / code review logs for the last two quarters (audit trail showing reviewers, comments, merge timestamps)
- CI/CD pipeline run examples and pipeline policies (including failure/rollback evidence)
- Secrets management evidence: KMS/HSM rotation policy, example rotation report, vault access logs for service accounts
- Change management runbook or approval workflow (Jira links or runbook PDF)
- Any automated gating (PR gating, static analysis) snapshots used during builds

If anything needs to be redacted, mark it and provide a justification. We will accept attachments or secure drive links. Confirm receipt and point of contact for artifact delivery.

Regards,
Ellen Park
Senior Assessor — BrightShield Audit
assessor@brightshield.audit

[Note: please keep this thread focused on artifact delivery; technical clarifications can be routed to Redwood eng leads]

Team — Ellen from BrightShield sent FinBank's SIG request. They want the SDLC artifacts by EOD Friday (2028-02-03). Can we assemble a delivery bundle and a short cover note?

Immediate asks:
- Marissa: please export PR/code review logs for 2027 Q3–Q4 and Q1 2028 (include reviewer identities, timestamps, and any formal approvals). A CSV export + a short README explaining the fields would be ideal.
- Neha: include sample CI runs that show successful and failed builds (the pipeline screenshot + junit summary + the pipeline YAML snippet). Mark where static analysis gates ran.
- Vivek: confirm when KMS key rotations occurred in the last 12 months and attach the rotation report; include statement on vault access controls.

I'll compile and send back to Ellen once we have the artifacts. If anything is sensitive, flag it and include a redaction note. Aim to drop everything into the shared evidence folder: https://drive.redwoodinternal.com/finbank/sig/evidence-20280201

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael — attaching the PR/code review exports you asked for. Notes below.

Attachments: [Attachment: sdlc_pr_review_logs_2027Q4.csv (CSV - 312KB)], [Attachment: change_management_runbook.pdf (PDF - 1.2MB)]

Quick notes on the CSV: columns include pr_id, repo, author, reviewers (comma-separated), created_at, merged_at, approvals_count, labels, review_comments_count. We filtered out non-production repos per FinBank's scope; if they need full org scope, tell me and I'll run a wider export.

On merging policy: we enforce at least one approving review + green CI check for all production branches. The change_management_runbook (attached) shows the approval flow and emergency change path (pages 4–6).

Rafael / team — adding CI artifacts to the folder and a short explanation of gating.

Attachments: [Attachment: ci_pipeline_run_20280115.png (PNG - 215KB)], [Attachment: ci_junit_summary_20280115.txt (TXT - 48KB)]

Details: the screenshot is from a production pipeline run that failed a static analysis step (linter) and then was fixed in the subsequent commit; the junit summary shows test pass/fail counts. We also included a snippet of the pipeline YAML in the Drive folder that highlights the gate step (static-analysis -> unit-tests -> deploy-staging). The pipeline enforces branch protection and blocks merges until the "ci-green" status is present.

Drive path: https://drive.redwoodinternal.com/finbank/sig/evidence-20280201/ci
